status_overrides.source_name: EIA 2026 Refinery Capacity Report, Table 3, printed p.14 (PDF p.10)
status_overrides.note: EIA identifies CPI Operations LLC, Paulsboro, as fully idle on January 1, 2026. This is separate from operating Paulsboro Refining Co LLC (IIR 1008919); a shared town or parent must not transfer the idle status to that complex. No subsequent dated restart was verified. IIR crude capacity and unit rows are retained on their original basis; EIA idle capacity is recorded separately.

status_overrides.source_name: Sky Quarry Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, signed August 12, 2026, Note 3
status_overrides.note: EIA lists Foreland Refining Corp, Ely, as fully idle on January 1, 2026. Sky Quarry's Q2 Form 10-Q, signed August 12, explicitly says operations had not yet restarted as of the report date, despite earlier July startup plans. Its undated homepage describes active processing; no later dated confirmation of completed restart was verified. This is a dated status with restart uncertainty, not a September operating observation. Original IIR capacity and unit rows are retained; EIA idle capacities use different documented day bases.
